design_archetype.name: THE PERFORMANCE INDUSTRIAL TRADER
design_archetype.description: A sturdy, high-contrast, trustworthy B2B & retail construction material trading aesthetic. Combines gunmetal slate structure, concrete off-white surfaces, and high-visibility industrial amber/gold accents to deliver immediate authority and effortless mobile-first ordering.
anti_patterns_avoided: No flimsy thin borders or low contrast text on dark backgrounds

typography.font_family_body: Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, sans-serif
typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace

scale.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight leading-none
scale.mono_price: font-mono font-bold text-amber-700 text-lg sm:text-xl text-right md:text-left

spacing_and_layout.bento_grid_catalog: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6

card_components: Product photo thumbnail with brand tag
Multiple brand price & stock selector dropdown / tabs
Price per bag / ton with unit calculator
Add to Cart button & Quick WhatsApp Quote button

steps: 1. Cart Drawer / Modal: Item list, selected brand, quantity, per unit price, total price
2. Delivery Site Details: Customer name, phone, site delivery address, delivery urgency date, site contact

3. Payment QR & WhatsApp Forwarding: Shows active UPI QR Code with rotated UPI ID, displays 2-day ₹3 Lakh limit badge, copy UPI ID button, and 'Send Order Details via WhatsApp' button which opens wa.me with formatted order string

upi_rotation_logic.rule: Rotates UPI ID automatically or via admin setting if current UPI ID accumulated 2-day total >= ₹300,000

meeting_booking.purpose: Site Visit / Bulk Pricing Consultation / Wholesale Deal Booking
meeting_booking.behavior: Saves meeting request in DB (visible in Admin Dashboard) and triggers WhatsApp message to +91 9440828759

admin_dashboard.access: Pin / Password Login Modal or Page (Default credentials: admin / admin123)
modules: Product Management: Add/edit product title, photo URL, category, unit (Bag / Ton / KG / Bundle), add multiple brands per product with editable price and stock count
UPI Rotation Manager: Manage active UPI IDs, view 2-day received amount, switch active UPI ID, edit limit thresholds
Orders Log: View all guest order attempts, status (Pending, Paid via UPI, Confirmed, Delivered), filter by date, copy WhatsApp receipt string
Meeting Requests: Manage site visit and consultation bookings, mark status (New, Scheduled, Completed), instant WhatsApp reply button

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use full transparent headers or background panels where text overlaps images.

All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, tabs, cards, dropdowns) MUST include data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='product-card-ultratech', data-testid='checkout-submit-whatsapp-button').
Use sonner for toast notifications (located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx).
Ensure total price calculations in cart accurately multiply unit price by quantity and update instantly.
Provide sample default product items pre-loaded in state/localStorage/backend so the public store is populated with cement and steel TMT rods out of the box.
